identity.description: Read and manage your Firewalla router from the gateway: MSP API (boxes, devices, rules, alarms, flows, stats, target lists) and read-only SSH (interfaces, routes, DHCP leases).

sections.title: Firewalla
sections.description: Connect your Firewalla MSP account and box. Write tools stay off until you turn them on, and every write still needs confirm: true.

fields.label: MSP domain
fields.description: Your MSP domain without https://, for example mycompany.firewalla.net.

fields.label: MSP API token
fields.description: Personal access token from MSP Settings → MSP API. Write-only.

fields.label: Box address
fields.description: LAN address of the Firewalla box for SSH reads, for example 192.168.1.1.

fields.label: Enable write tools
fields.description: Allows MSP changes (rename devices, rules, alarms, target lists). Each call still needs confirm: true.

fields.label: Enable SSH writes
fields.description: Reserved. No SSH write tools exist yet; network and DHCP changes over SSH are planned after on-box verification.
